column1: # Game profile of Patrick's Parabox (Switch, update 1.0.1 = v65536). Plays on the Mac and on the iPhone
# Unity 2020.3.30f1 (IL2CPP), SDK 13.3.7: the shaders are Unity's built-in Shader objects in Data/Resources (unity default resources, unity_builtin_extra), which carry no type trees and no bundle
# lends one; unityfs.py has Unity 2020.3's Shader layout (KNOWN_TREES, the tree of Fire Emblem Engage's bundles). The game's only font, Jost, falls back to the shared fonts for Japanese, Korean
# and Chinese, which Unity hands to FreeType as TTFs (hle_sdk16.c font_skip)
# Controller only (stick or D-pad to move, A to confirm): it stays docked (1920x1080) with the default 2D pad layout

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie)

# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource, so IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is true: nninitStartup (main+0x1cd010) hands application pool − used memory to StandardAllocator as virtual address memory

# and never calls SetMemoryHeapSize. The node area cut for this sdk build (dm/tools/sdk_patches.py) shrinks the AddressRegionManager's node area to 62 MB, as for Ace Attorney Investigations Collection and
# Brain Memory Training Academy, whose layout this is: a 1 GB pool and the 5 GB block (256 MB in front + 4.375 GB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 128 MB heap region)
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py; Unity Shader objects, read by unityfs.py) ----
# engine built-ins (Resources/: unity default resources, unity_builtin_extra) go to engine, the player's serialized files to data
